Install Global AI Instructions

Source: R/rProject-ai-global.R
AIGlobal.Rd

Copies the global AI instructions and Claude settings from .setup/ai/global in the project to the configuration folders of Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot in the home directory. Files are written only when their content changed. Existing files that differ are backed up with the suffix .bak.

Usage

AIGlobal(path, home = Sys.getenv("HOME"))

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

home

Character string. Home directory.

Value

Returns the paths of the files that were written.

Details

SourceInstalled to
AGENTS.md~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
AGENTS.md~/.codex/AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md
claude-settings.json~/.claude/settings.json
